en: Psalms 77
For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph.

zh: 亞薩的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。

p.src: 1  My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

en: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
u.src: 1  My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

p.src: 2  In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

en: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
u.src: 2  In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

p.src: 3  I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

en: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.
u.src: 3  I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

p.src: 4  You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

en: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
u.src: 4  You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

p.src: 5  I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
u.src: 5  I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

p.src: 6  I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

en: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
u.src: 6  I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

p.src: 7  “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

en: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
u.src: 7  “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

p.src: 8  Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

en: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
u.src: 8  Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

p.src: 9  Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

en: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.
u.src: 9  Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

p.src: 10  Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

en: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
u.src: 10  Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

p.src: 11  I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

en: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
u.src: 11  I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

p.src: 12  I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

en: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
u.src: 12  I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

p.src: 13  Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

en: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
u.src: 13  Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

p.src: 14  You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

en: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
u.src: 14  You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

p.src: 15  You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

en: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
u.src: 15  You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

p.src: 16  The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

en: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
u.src: 16  The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

p.src: 17  The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

en: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
u.src: 17  The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

p.src: 18  The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

en: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
u.src: 18  The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

p.src: 19  Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

en: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
u.src: 19  Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

p.src: 20  You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

en: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
u.src: 20  You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
